en-US.releaseNotes:
What's new in Wave Link 3.4?

🎙️ Introducing Wave Go
One wireless mic, two ways to use it. Wave Go clips on for hands-free recording or slots into the Smart Handle for interviews. A single USB-C receiver connects to your phone or computer for instant broadcast-quality audio, with up to 48 hours of runtime. Just plug in, power on, and go.
🔗 Discover Wave Go

🛠️ Improvements & bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where the saved configuration could be lost after a PC restart.
- Fixed an issue where a duplicate entry in the saved configuration reset all settings to defaults.
- Fixed an issue where a Wave input could stay silent after starting Windows or reconnecting the device.
- Fixed an issue where a Wave input produced no signal when its mix had no available output device.
- Fixed an issue where Wave Link could fail to start because a Windows notification service was unresponsive.
- Fixed a crash at startup that could happen when a renamed audio device was disconnected.
- Fixed an issue where the driver could get stuck in an install loop after a Windows update while a Wave XLR Pro was connected.
- Fixed an issue where some external hardware inputs, including capture cards and virtual audio cables, stayed unavailable after a driver update.
- Fixed an issue where channels removed from the Mixes view still counted toward the four external hardware input limit.
- Fixed an issue where the Voice Focus level was reset to 95% every time Wave Link restarted.
- Fixed an issue where volume, gain and monitoring sliders jittered when dragged slowly.
- Fixed an issue where effects from a deleted channel were applied to the next channel created in its place.
- Fixed an issue where effects could not be copied from an input whose hardware device was unavailable.
- Fixed an issue where Sound Check playback went silent when the output device was changed during playback.
- Fixed an issue where the video on the real-time voice monitoring screen turned black after resizing the window.
- Fixed an issue where long device names were cut off awkwardly in dropdowns. Names now truncate to one line, with the full name shown as a tooltip.
- Wave XLR Pro: Fixed an issue where Wave Link could crash during the hardware and software mixer transition.
- Wave XLR Pro: Fixed an issue where additional Wave hardware devices didn't get default effects.
- Wave XLR: Fixed an issue where hardware settings, including Clipguard, Low Impedance Mode, Low Cut Filter, and Gain, reset after a full PC restart.
- Corsair VOXARA: Fixed an issue where the mute button didn't always show the most recently selected color after several quick changes.

Want to share feedback on Wave Link 3.4? Connect with us:
- Leave a comment on our Subreddit
- Chat with fellow community members on Discord
- Hit up @elgato on X
- Discover more on Explorer
- Contact our Support Team
